description: Verify a pending registration after publishing the returned token at /.well-known/appside-verify.txt or in a meta name="appside-verify" content="TOKEN" tag on the submitted website. For itch.io, put the token anywhere in the public text of the exact submitted game page (edit its description). Store-only apps put the token in every submitted public store description. Success makes the catalog page searchable and indexable.

token.description: Optional Appside bearer token. Associates registrations with your account. Store securely; never log it.

name: verify_app
